'''Perit''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during the time of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]].

==Biography==
Perit started his career as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], owned by an [[Unidentified Sienar Fleet Systems executive|executive]] of [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], the head of the [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]] facility; initially given the duties of a household servant, but his sense of duty, and talents with technology, soon saw him promoted to personal assistant. During that time he managed a big part of corporate duties on behalf of his master, and gained experience on the company's [[datanet/Legends|datanet]], as well as the [[Service droid/Legends|assistant]] and [[Courier droid/Legends|messenger]] [[droid/Legends|droids]]. He learned [[slicer/Legends|slicing]] by himself which allowed him to snoop around Sienar's secrets, even research projects, personnel files, and private data that high-level executives collected to blackmail their competitors.<ref name="sb" />

Then he received an official Imperial slave reassignment. Although this indicated that his movements were monitored, Perit was not sure if it was a recognition of a slave's intelligence and talents, or some plot to execute and get rid of him for what he knew. In any case he was transferred to the [[Imperial Center Construction Contracts Division]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="sb" />

Perit came to the attention of Xizor, a Vigo of Black Sun. Xizor arranged for him to be transferred to his household, showing him how to use his talents for profit. He soon became a [[Sublieutenant/Legends|sublieutenant]] of the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] Vigo. Right when Xizor became the [[Underlord]] of Black Sun, he appointed Perit as his successor in the Vigo council. Perit and Xizor maintained their close friendship ever since, being a subject of jealousy by the other vigos<ref name="sb" /> but Perit's skills gave him access to much ruinous information on his competition.

As a Vigo, Perit became in charge of Xizor's former operations, but eventually he focused on crime related to computers and technology, such as laundering and bank fraud, bugging datanets and stealing secrets, and even tampering with [[sector/Legends|Sectorial]] economies. He continued taking pride of his tech abilities, that allowed him to oversee some of these operations. Perit's criminal network included a mole within [[Renik]],  [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanese]] [[Bank/Legends|bankers]] with contacts to financial entities, [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[slicer/Legends|slicers]], [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[technician/Legends|mechanics]] and dummy financial corporations for illegal money transfers.<ref name="sb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] Perit discovered that another Vigo's sublieutenant involved with Perit's [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] trade was lining his pockets with Perit's [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. In order to avoid an open war with the other Vigos, he hired independent operatives to ambush the sublieutenant's stronghold and kill him, making it look like a pirate attack.<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}} - Terminal mission "Take Out Cheating Spice Dealer"</ref>

[[Guri]] ordered him to bribe his contact within Renik and transfer some Imperial credits into Renik's subsidiaries and, aided by Perit's slicers, into [[Viera Cheran]]'s account, a bribe for the assassination of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="sb" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' during that time.</ref> Xizor summoned all his Vigos to [[Xizor's Palace|his Palace]], and they all complied. They all gathered in the antechamber, and were relieved of their weapons by [[Howzmin]]. Everyone knew that Xizor discovered something and wanted to make an example of the culpit to the remaining eight of them. As for Perit, at first he was certain it was not him, otherwise he would know it from his electronic spies that reported from the Vigos and even the Palace; but in an afterthought he wondered if Xizor knew about it, which he would not appreciate. This uncertainty made him nervous until they were summoned by [[Guri]].<ref name="obvious">{{WEGCite|story=The Obvious Scapegoat|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref> At the conclusion of the meeting, Perit witnessed as Xizor had Guri [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Green]] in front of the other Vigos, as a message to any Vigos who would try to sell information.<ref name="guri">{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=Beautiful... and Lethal|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC009.jpg}}</ref><ref name="novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>
==Equipment==
Perit owned a [[Mon Calamari starliner]] called the ''[[Red Tide]]''.

He was aware of the jealousy and spite the other Vigos felt for him, and he relied on technology to ensure his own safety, and covered his space and movements with sophisticated security systems, and carefully placed and hidden [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]].<ref name="sb" /> His gadgets spied on the other Vigos's organizations, even Xizor's own Palace.<ref name="obvious" />
